newsitem.title: USA: E&S Holdings FY sales rise nine pct.
newsitem.headline: E&S Holdings FY sales rise nine pct.

text.p: E&S Holdings Corp, the parent company of Spalding Sports and Evenflo Co Inc, said on Thursday that its sales for the year ended September 30, 1996, increased nine percent to $689 million from $634 million the prior year.
E&S Holdings, a privately held firm which is majority owned by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co LP, said Spalding's sales were boosted by its golf products and strength in its basketball business.
Evenflo's sales increased 13 percent from higher car seat sales and new product introductions.
Further financial details were not immediately available.
E&S Holdings said it expects continued growth internally and by acquisitions.
